headline: Qualcomm Shares Fall 6% as Revenue Declines Amid Data Center Expansion
summary: Qualcomm shares fell 6% after the company reported a drop in revenue while pursuing an expansion into data center technologies.
why: Qualcomm is a major semiconductor and telecommunications equipment company known for mobile processors and wireless technology patents.

impacts.name: Qualcomm
impacts.why: Lower revenue figures directly impacted investor sentiment, driving the stock price down by 6%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A contraction in revenue combined with heavy capital investments in new markets can pressure short-term profitability and equity value.
